title: Export Proof
user: People publishing diagrams, collaborative pixel canvases, and teaching visuals who need confidence that a PNG/PDF export says the same thing as the live canvas.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension that captures a canvas's visible semantic text and bounding boxes, compares them locally with a rendered PNG/PDF, and emits an annotated proof image.
success_measure: On a seeded set of 30 export defects, flag at least 25 while producing fewer than three false warnings.
constraints: All captures stay local by default; OCR is optional; never bypass application authentication or canvas-origin protections.
